title: Dora and the Map
description: Dora the Explorer stands inside a large mechanical barrel labeled 'DORA THE MAP' while holding up a corner of an enormous, unfurled treasure map covered in cartoonish drawings, handprints, and the words 'GAB CAST'. A smaller glowing version of Dora stands to the left. The background features a dark, gothic fantasy castle with glowing windows under a purple and orange twilight sky with a large yellow moon. Two black winged cat-like creatures hover near the map.
